Ottawa, ON | On-site | Student Role – January 2027

Position Overview

Calian's AI Integration team builds internal automation and tools powered by AI that make daily work easier for groups across the business, including finance, engineering, HR, and manufacturing. These tools are built quickly to solve real problems, so they need to be made reliable, thoroughly tested, and ready for everyday use.

This role exists to give that testing and hardening work a dedicated owner. The co-op student's main focus is software testing: putting our tools through their paces in a safe, sandboxed environment so they are solid before the people who rely on them use them. Alongside testing, the student takes on their own scoped projects, such as equipment tracking, and gets real opportunities to learn how to build automation with AI, with guidance at every step.

We are hiring for genuine enthusiasm. A curious, excited person who loves figuring out how things work can be taught the rest.

Responsibilities



-  Software tool testing (primary focus, the majority of the term): put newly built AI tools through their paces in a safe, sandboxed environment. Find edge cases, try to break things, document issues, and confirm fixes before tools reach the people who use them.
-  Test equipment automation: help script and automate tests that involve lab or test equipment, making repetitive test runs faster and more repeatable.
-  Own scoped projects: take ownership of clearly defined projects such as equipment tracking, with the guidance needed to succeed.
-  Opportunities to build (occasional, growth oriented): as the student grows, take on real build tasks and learn to create AI tools, supported by mentorship and review.
-  Collaboration and documentation: work with contacts across departments to understand what tools need to do, and write simple notes so others can use them.
-  Other duties as required within the context of the role.

Qualifications

This is a student work term. No prior professional experience is required.

Education



-  Currently enrolled in a college or University program. Students from any computer, engineering, or technology program are welcome to apply.

Required



-  Genuine enthusiasm for automation and AI. This matters most by far. Show us you are excited through a personal project or a story about something you built. It does not have to be about automation. Show us something you have made that you are proud of.
-  Curiosity and a “let us see how this works, and how it breaks” mindset.
-  Willingness to spend the term focused on testing, knowing that real chances to build are part of the role.
-  Some comfort with programming is a plus and, above all, an eagerness to learn.

Nice to have (assets)



-  Any experience with lab or test equipment.
-  Experience experimenting with AI tools, LLMs, or building with prompts.
-  Familiarity with version control (git), Excel and spreadsheet automation, or scripting on Windows.

Compensation

$26.01- $28.82/hour

Vacancy

We have 1 available position.
fit_why: Primarily manual software testing with light scripting, not core full-stack build work

role: AI Engineering Intern, Voice & LLM Systems
jd:
About Presto Phoenix, Inc.

Presto is the leading Voice AI company for restaurant drive-thrus, operating at scale in complex, noisy, customer-facing environments. As the AI partner to more than a dozen of the most iconic American restaurant brands, Presto is building one of the most impactful real-world applications of AI, directly improving revenue, labor efficiency, and guest experience for millions of people.

Founded by alumni from MIT, the University of Waterloo and University of Illinois, Presto is built on a deeply technical, entrepreneurial engineering culture. We place a premium on ownership, speed, and first principles thinking, empowering engineers to move quickly, experiment boldly, and solve hard, real-world problems.

AI is not a feature at Presto, it is the foundation of how we build, evaluate, and evolve our products. We are backed by Remus Capital, were a Y Combinator company, and are headquartered in Silicon Valley.

This may not be the right fit if you're looking for a passive, low-ownership internship. We move at the pace of AI. Presto is for builders, experimenters, and problem-solvers who thrive in ambiguity and are excited to work on real-world AI systems alongside a high-performance team.

The Role

We are looking for Winter 2027 AI Engineering Interns to contribute to the core intelligence behind Presto's Voice AI platform.

This is a hands-on technical internship at the intersection of large language models, real-time systems, and production AI. You will work on systems that power live customer interactions across thousands of restaurant locations, where performance, latency, and reliability matter.

You'll gain direct exposure to the full AI development lifecycle, from prototyping new capabilities to supporting production deployments.

What You'll Do



- Assist in building and improving AI/ML components used in real-time voice interactions.
- Experiment with LLM-based systems, including prompt design, workflow iteration, and behavioral testing.
- Help clean, structure, and filter real-world datasets to improve model performance and evaluation quality.
- Contribute to fast iteration cycles, ramping quickly on existing codebases and delivering with minimal oversight.
- Collaborate with engineering, product, and AI teams to translate real-world problems into practical solutions.
- Stay current with the latest advancements in AI, LLMs, and applied machine learning.


What We're Looking For



- Currently pursuing a bachelor's or master's degree in computer science, AI, machine learning, or a related field.
- Strong programming fundamentals in Python.
- Coursework or project experience in machine learning, NLP, or AI systems.
- Familiarity with ML frameworks such as PyTorch or TensorFlow.
- Curiosity, adaptability, and a strong desire to learn in a fast-moving environment.
- Ability to manage priorities and communicate technical ideas clearly.


Nice to Have



- Hands-on experience with LLM APIs or building AI-powered applications (coursework, personal projects, or research).
- Exposure to cloud platforms such as AWS, GCP, or Azure.
- Experience with real-time, low-latency, or voice/conversational systems.
- Familiarity with data pipelines or working with large, messy datasets.


Why Intern at Presto

You'll work on production AI systems deployed at meaningful scale, with real ownership over your contributions. You'll be immersed in a high-performance, entrepreneurial engineering environment, iterating quickly, learning constantly, and shipping work that directly impacts millions of customer interactions.

Compensation & Benefits

Presto offers competitive internship compensation commensurate with experience and location. Interns also receive hands-on mentorship, exposure to a high-performance AI team, and the opportunity to convert to a full-time role based on performance.

Our Commitment

We value people from all walks of life and are committed to building an inclusive, equitable work environment. We strongly encourage candidates from historically underrepresented backgrounds to apply. Presto Phoenix, Inc. is an equal opportunity employer.

If you need an accommodation to access the application or interview process, please contact recruiting@presto.com.
fit_why: Python AI/LLM app work fits; requires ML framework familiarity and training-side work

Perks of being a CGI Co-op:

The co-op program was designed to help students improve their skills and explore their professional interests through hands-on experience and professional guidance, while also helping them develop core competencies. As an intern, you have access to:



-  Professional development sessions
-  Professional development platform
-  Networking events with colleagues and leaders
-  Mentorship from leaders and colleagues aimed at setting and achieving your career goals

Start Date: January 2027

Application Deadline: November 29th, 2026

Work mode: On site, 5 days in the office

CGI is providing a reasonable estimate of the pay range for this role. The determination of this range includes factors such as skill set level, geographic market, experience and training, and licenses and certifications. Compensation decisions depend on the facts and circumstances of each case. A reasonable estimate of the current range is $18-32/hour. This role is an existing vacancy.

Your future duties and responsibilities



-  Understand client requirements and system specifications
-  Develop applications and web components according to the best practices established by the team
-  Prepare the required functional and technical documentation
-  Ensure code quality through rigorous testing
-  Review code and suggest improvements
-  Document technical processes
-  Manage the technical knowledge library
-  Deploy code to non-production environments or develop code automation scripts
-  Diligently follow the prescribed training paths and prepare for the associated certifications

Required Qualifications To Be Successful In This Role



-  Currently studying computer science, computer engineering, or a related field
-  Interest in and ability to learn specialized tools, technologies, and software packages that may not be widely used in the industry or taught in academic programs
-  Ability to develop specifications, code, test, debug, and document programs, and ensure their successful implementation and maintenance
-  Experience with object-oriented design, back-end development, and user interface development
-  Thorough understanding of database design principles, query execution plans, stored procedures, and SQL scripting languages (PL/SQL, T-SQL)

Assets



-  Knowledge of .NET/C#, GitHub Copilot, and React
-  Bilingualism (French and English) is considered an asset for this position, as the role involves interacting with national and global clients

Together, as owners, let’s turn meaningful insights into action.

Life at CGI is rooted in ownership, teamwork, respect and belonging. Here, you’ll reach your full potential because…

You are invited to be an owner from day 1 as we work together to bring our Dream to life. That’s why we call ourselves CGI Partners rather than employees. We benefit from our collective success and actively shape our company’s strategy and direction.

Your work creates value. You’ll develop innovative solutions and build relationships with teammates and clients while accessing global capabilities to scale your ideas, embrace new opportunities, and benefit from expansive industry and technology expertise.

You’ll shape your career by joining a company built to grow and last. You’ll be supported by leaders who care about your health and well-being and provide you with opportunities to deepen your skills and broaden your horizons.

At CGI, we value the strength that diversity brings and are committed to fostering a workplace where everyone belongs. We collaborate with our clients to build more inclusive communities and empower all CGI partners to thrive. As an equal-opportunity employer, being able to perform your best during the recruitment process is important to us. If you require an accommodation, please inform your recruiter.

That same commitment to fairness extends to how we use technology. To support our recruitment team, AI tools may be used to help assess applications though they never replace human judgement. All hiring decisions remain entirely in the hands of our recruitment professionals.

To learn more about accessibility at CGI, contact us via email. Please note that this email is strictly for accessibility requests and cannot be used for application status inquiries.

Come join our team—one of the largest IT and business consulting services firms in the world.
